title: Scenario A — Breaking Field Rename (customer_id → customerId)
description: orders-api renames response field 'customer_id' to 'customerId' (PR #142 passes isolated provider tests). checkout-client still reads payload['customer_id'] (PR #89 passes isolated unit tests against a stale mock). When combined, checkout-client crashes with KeyError: 'customer_id'.

diffs.summary: PR #142: Standardize JSON response keys to camelCase (`customer_id` -> `customerId`)
PR #89: Add checkout telemetry header while reading `payload["customer_id"]` tested against stale mock

suggested_fix: Update checkout-client (`repos/checkout-client/client.py`) to read `payload.get("customerId") or payload["customer_id"]`, or retain `customer_id` alongside `customerId` in `orders-api` during the deprecation window.
pr_a_title: PR #142 (orders-api): Migrate customer payload key to camelCase `customerId`
pr_b_title: PR #89 (checkout-client): Add checkout session metadata (uses mocked `customer_id`)
consumer_mock_note: Isolated consumer unit test (`test_consumer_unit.py`) uses a hardcoded stale mock `{"customer_id": "cus_123", "status": "active"}` that hides the breaking provider change.
